content:
Apple has released the second iOS 27.3 developer beta for iPhone. The upcoming software update includes the redesigned Health app, new Safari features, expanded Siri AI capabilities, and more.

The second beta follows the first developer release on November 3 and first public beta on November 5.

One of the biggest changes introduced in iOS 27.3 so far is the redesigned Health app, which briefly appeared during iOS 27.2 testing before being removed ahead of release.

On supported iPhones, Health’s new Insights tab brings together trends from sleep, activity, and more. A new Longevity tab includes Health Age, which uses Apple Watch data to compare your health metrics with what’s typical for your age.

Other changes introduced in the first iOS 27.3 beta include:

  • Safari: Vertical Tabs and Adaptive Dark Mode offer a new tab layout and a way to darken websites that don’t support Dark Mode.
  • Siri AI: New capabilities across Apple apps let you create and save Music playlists, schedule messages to send later, create Journal entries, and more.
  • iPhone Duo: Reachability shifts content horizontally toward either side of the display to make one-handed use easier.
  • StandBy: Updated clock faces bring more customization to other iPhones, including colors, complications, and multiple configurations.
  • Apple Fitness+: Gym Strength creates a four-week lifting plan based on your goals and available equipment.

Our full iOS 27.3 beta 1 roundup covers additional changes, including expanded Siri AI language support and Apple Music updates.

Developer beta testers can check for the update by opening Settings, choosing General, then Software Update. Select iOS 27 Developer Beta under Beta Updates.

Stay tuned as we update our devices and explore iOS 27.3 beta 2 for further changes. Find something new? Share your discoveries in the comments or email tips@9to5mac.com.
